dict.string: Sifu needs Accessibility access to track your workflow — clicks, keystrokes, and app switches. All data stays 100% local on your machine.
Sifu needs Screen Recording access to capture screenshots of your workflow. All data stays 100% local on your machine.
Sifu reads the active tab's URL from your browser so recorded web steps can be replayed and turned into skills. All data stays 100% local on your machine.
